dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Bye, Nam! My taxi is here.
dialogue.reading: ˈbaɪ, ˈnɑːm! maɪ ˈtæksi ɪz ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Bye, Emma! Text me from the airport, OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈbaɪ, ˈɛmə! ˈtɛkst miː frəm ði ˈɛrpɔːrt, oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I won't. Oh, can you remind me about my Thai test in January?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwoʊnt. ˈoʊ, kən juː rɪˈmaɪnd miː əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈtaɪ ˈtɛst ɪn ˈdʒænjuɛri?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll text you next month. I won't forget!
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. aɪl ˈtɛkst juː ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ. aɪ ˈwoʊnt fərˈɡɛt!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks! I'll call you next week.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! aɪl ˈkɔːl juː ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk.
